dataIdInfo.idPurp: This dataset was derived from a number of sources, the NGI river layer, NFEPA rivers, Cullum streams (2011). These were manually edited in 2018 using the NGI aerial imagery to improve the resolution of some of the rivers. Where names were missing they were updated using the Andy and Lorrain Tinker's Kruger Park map book.
